task: Partial stopgap for #217: pin the Air-Gap E2E job's runner to ubuntu-24.04 so the xfs and btrfs jobs stop failing on ubuntu-26.04's kind image load. ext4 is NOT fixed by this (runner kernel 7.0.0-1017-azure has no linux-modules-extra on either image) and stays tracked in #217.

events.summary: Only `runs-on` of the e2e-airgap job changed (ubuntu-latest -> ubuntu-24.04) plus a D1 comment. Not touched: E2E scripts, manifests, agent code, chart, other workflows (ci.yaml / release.yaml still on ubuntu-latest; risk recorded in #217).

Reproduced from GitHub Actions history: scheduled E2E run 39221341848 (2026-10-19, runner image ubuntu-24.04) succeeded for xfs/ext4/btrfs; runs 40290897461 (2026-10-26) and 41427109519 (2026-11-02), both on image ubuntu-26.04 with no E2E-related repo change in between, failed all three. 41427109519 log: `ctr: rpc error: code = NotFound desc = content digest sha256:71b0cbca... not found` during `kind load docker-image` (xfs/btrfs); ext4 lacks linux-modules-extra for the 26.04 kernel.
Pinned the e2e-airgap job to ubuntu-24.04 with a decision comment naming the cost, the ext4 limitation and the escape hatch (#217).

PR #218's pull_request E2E run 41848516963 on ubuntu-24.04 (image 20261025.353): xfs and btrfs jobs passed (kind image load works again); the ext4 job failed at 'Install Host Tools' with `E: Unable to locate package linux-modules-extra-7.0.0-1017-azure` -- a separate kernel-side cause the pin does not address. Verification passed is claimed for the xfs/btrfs defect only.
events.scope: CI-runner level, xfs and btrfs only: proves the kind image-load failure is runner-image-specific and gone on 24.04. Does not restore ext4 E2E and adds no new quota enforcement evidence; ext4 and ubuntu-26.04 support are tracked in #217.

events.summary: Air-Gap E2E xfs and btrfs jobs pass again on ubuntu-24.04 (run 41848516963). ext4 still fails for a kernel-module reason recorded in #217.
Partial stopgap: xfs/btrfs restored; ext4 and 26.04 deferred to #217.
